Prism shows your agenda for the day (meetings, Teams links), read locally from Calendar.
Prism records your voice while you hold the dictation button, to write a prompt to an agent. The audio stays in memory on this Mac.
Prism turns what you dictate into a prompt with macOS's speech recognition, on this Mac only.
